scripts.run.py:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,sys,math,datetime,hashlib
out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;commands=[]
def expected(n):return 33*n

def save(n,v):(out/n).write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n')
def run(stage,index=1):
 cmd=[sys.executable,str(out/'worker.py'),stage,'two-r-fetch','--series',str(index)];commands.append(cmd);save('commands.json',commands)
 with (out/f'{stage}-{index}.log').open('wb') as f:r=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 assert r.returncode==0,(stage,index,r.returncode)
 return json.loads((out/f'two-r-fetch-{stage}-{index}.json').read_text())
c={'name':'two-r-fetch','iterations':100000000,'definition':': BENCH-RUN 0 BENCH-ITERATIONS 0 DO 11 22 2>R 2R@ + + 2R> 2DROP LOOP ;','checksum_expected':expected(100000000)};save('two-r-fetch-config.json',c);save('start.json',{'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'protocol_sha256':hashlib.sha256((out/'protocol.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
p=run('pilot');cpu=p['engines']['baseline']['median_us'];assert cpu>0;n=math.ceil(100000000*6000000/cpu);c['iterations']=n;c['checksum_expected']=expected(n);c['baseline_pilot_cpu_us']=cpu;save('two-r-fetch-config.json',c)
aa=[run('aa',i) for i in (1,2)];delta=max(x['aa_delta_percent'] for x in aa);minimum=min(v['median_us'] for x in aa for v in x['engines'].values());save('aa-summary.json',{'delta_percent':delta,'minimum_median_us':minimum,'iterations':n});print('target AA',n,minimum,delta,flush=True)
if minimum<5000000 or delta>2:save('stop.json',{'reason':'fresh target calibration unresolved; candidate not timed; no retry'});raise SystemExit(0)
ab=[run('compare',i) for i in (1,2)];changes=[x['change_percent'] for x in ab];save('target-result.json',{'changes_percent':changes,'target_only':True,'not_adopted':True,'global_and_Linux_comparisons_still_required':True});print('target AB',changes,flush=True);save('complete.json',{'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'not_adopted':True})

limitation: sum checksum does not detect reordered pair; order verified by separate boundary tests. Additional parent logging not directly child CPU.
